acceptedObservations.finding: All runtime imports resolve within these three source files. They perform transformations only: no Main/dataset scripts, database, network, accounts, permissions, filesystem, services or citation writes. Identity key/provider/namespace/externalId are caller coordinates; the library does not allocate persistent native identity.

Runtime public exports are convertProviderRecord, convertBangumiSubject and ProviderConversionError; ProviderRecordIdentity is a TypeScript interface. Errors expose only record/unsupported basis. The explicit optional server interface is neither introduced nor required by this cut.

The unchanged portable test preserves empty strings, CRLF/tab text, null, partial-looking date and decimal strings, false, empty arrays, repeated array values, omitted properties and exact EN-us language casing in the raw data. Plain input remains unchanged. VNDB valid string name/language are retained; nullish language falls through olang, lang, und. MusicBrainz accepts string language only and otherwise uses und.

Valid summary strings and repeated tag values keep their exact text and ordinal pointers. Unknown top-level fields appear as unsupported with undeclared-field reason; mismatched subject ID and unsupported numeric type are refused. No enrichment or health/business inference is added.

The independent control passes all seven declared VNDB native-kind mappings and rejects empty/ordinary unknown namespace and unknown provider. The unchanged owner test rejects mismatched identity and bare Bangumi provider enrichment. These controls do not erase CONV-REFUSAL-1.

The owner test copies only manifest and three source files into a fresh directory and executes the copied TypeScript entry in a Bun subprocess without Main/importer imports. Static import closure agrees. This demonstrates self-contained source use under Bun, with the distribution/runtime limits below.

actionableFindings.title: Reject inherited object-property names as unsupported VNDB namespaces
actionableFindings.defectClass: Untrusted string indexes a prototype-bearing object as though it were a closed allowlist.
actionableFindings.expected: Each undeclared VNDB namespace is refused with ProviderConversionError whose basis is unsupported, before returning a converted native kind.
actionableFindings.actual: The lookup inherits Object properties. constructor and toString return functions as native, disappearing in JSON; __proto__ returns Object.prototype, serialized as native: {}. No error is thrown. Type assertions disguise the runtime nonstring value.
actionableFindings.impact: A standalone caller using the exported string-valued namespace interface receives success and an invalid native classification for unsupported input; serialized output can even omit native. No prototype mutation or application security exploit is claimed.

failedCases: unsupported VNDB namespace constructor is refused instead of yielding a nonstring native kind
unsupported VNDB namespace __proto__ is refused instead of yielding a nonstring native kind
unsupported VNDB namespace toString is refused instead of yielding a nonstring native kind
evidence.failure: Expected ProviderConversionError; received undefined. 2 passing control/characterization cases, 3 failing refusal cases, 21 assertions; failures occur in test bodies after the real converter returned.
